packages.label: חֳלִי הַקַּדַּחַת וּפְגַם הַדַּעַת
packages.label_en: Fever Illness and the Blemish of Da'at
packages.reason: These three nodes share the same essential nature: the disordered union of fire and water. The verse 'we went through fire and water' (באנו באש ובמים) names the exact same fire-and-water structure that constitutes the fever (אש ומים, חמימות וקרירות). The fever itself is declared a bechina of the blemish of da'at because da'at's wholeness consists precisely in the correct union of fire and water — so its blemish is that same fire-water duality gone awry. All three are expressions of the same pathological reality: fire and water in destructive opposition rather than harmonious unity.
